question.prompt: Name a classic internet meme that first became popular in the 2000s or 2010s.
question.criteria: An image macro, viral video, catchphrase, or meme character that first gained widespread online recognition between 2000 and 2019.

answers.evidence: Doge pairs photographs of a Shiba Inu with colorful captions written in deliberately unusual English.
Distracted Boyfriend uses a stock photograph of a man looking at another woman while his partner reacts.
Grumpy Cat became a meme through photographs of a cat with a persistently displeased-looking expression.
Nyan Cat is an animated cat with a pastry body flying through space and leaving a rainbow trail.
Keyboard Cat features footage of a cat appearing to play an electronic keyboard.
Trollface is a grinning cartoon face associated with online trolling and rage comics.
This Is Fine depicts a cartoon dog calmly sitting in a burning room.
Hide the Pain Harold uses stock photographs of a smiling man whose expression is interpreted as concealed discomfort.
Chocolate Rain is a song and viral music video performed by Tay Zonday.
Dramatic Chipmunk is a short clip of a prairie dog turning toward the camera accompanied by dramatic music.
Philosoraptor is an image macro featuring a thoughtful-looking dinosaur and captions posing paradoxes or playful questions.
Socially Awkward Penguin is an image macro about embarrassing or uncomfortable social situations.
Forever Alone is a rage-comic character used to express loneliness and social isolation.
Business Cat is an image macro featuring a cat wearing a tie and captions mixing office language with feline behavior.
Longcat originated with a photograph of a white cat held upright to show its unusually long-looking body.
Rickrolling tricks someone into opening Rick Astley's music video for Never Gonna Give You Up.
Surprised Pikachu uses an open-mouthed image of Pikachu to react to an outcome that should have been predictable.
Success Kid uses a photograph of a toddler holding a clenched fist to celebrate small victories.
Bad Luck Brian pairs a school portrait with captions about unfortunate outcomes.
Expanding Brain arranges increasingly illuminated brain images beside a sequence of ideas.
Ermahgerd pairs a photograph of a girl holding Goosebumps books with deliberately distorted spellings.
Scumbag Steve pairs a photograph of a young man wearing a sideways cap with captions about inconsiderate behavior.
Me Gusta is a rage-comic face used to express pleasure or approval.
Advice Dog places a puppy's head on a multicolored background with captions offering absurd advice.
O RLY? uses a photograph of a snowy owl with an abbreviated version of the phrase oh really.

aliases: All Your Base Are Belong to Us
answers.evidence: All Your Base Are Belong to Us is a poorly translated line from Zero Wing that became an internet catchphrase.
Y U NO combines an agitated cartoon face with questions written in deliberately broken English.

question.explanation: These decades produced viral videos, captioned animal photos, rage-comic characters, and reaction images. Other documented memes from this period also count.
